name: Dynamic Mockups
author: dynamicmockups

sections.description:
Why Use This Plugin?

This plugin will let your create new product gallery in just a couple of seconds! And using our Product personalization feature, let your customers design and buy print-on-demand products on your store!

Features

  1. Create product gallery in just a couple of seconds for your new designs.
  2. Sell any print-on-demand product using our Product personalization feature and let your customers design and buy their own T-shirts, Mugs, Wall arts much more.
  3. Get ready for print personalized designs of your customers in WooCommerce order panel.

How to Use the Plugin?

  1. Connect with Dynamic Mockups app after activation.
  2. Your products will be synced automatically.
  3. Go to our web app and open “WooCommerce catalog”, create new collections and link them to your products.
  4. Easily create product gallery images in our WordPress plugin.
  5. Personalize any product and choose template for each of them.

Get Support

Join our Slack community to stay updated with new features and connect with our developers. Whether you need help troubleshooting, or guidance on how to maximize the plugin’s potential, our team is ready to assist you with any issues related to the WordPress plugin.

Download the plugin

Activate the plugin

Connect with Dynamic Mockups
sections.faq:
Can I use my PSD files?

Yes, you can use virtually any PSD file you have or you find on the internet.

Will my rendered Mockups be in High Quality?

Yes, we will always export your Mockups in Full Quality.

How long does it take to render the images?

It depends on how many images you have in your collection, most of the time the images are rendered in a couple of seconds!

Can I request a new feature?

Absolutely! We want to create the tools you need. Request a feature by sending your request to our support email or using the support page in the plugin.
